10.2 Late fee. Undisputed amounts outstanding for more than 0 days past the due date incur a late fee of 1.49% per month or part thereof. days_late = paid date - due date; no fee is due if days_late <= 0; otherwise n = ceil(days_late / 30) fee months, each fee_i = 1.49% x base_i rounded to cents, base_i per clause 10.3.
